# Descriptions
@@ 1
Turns 100 cubic feet of ice into water vapor.
@@ 2
Turns 10 cubic feet of earth into fine dust.
@@ 3
Any previous cracks or flaws within a section of any normal material 1,000
cubic feet (10'x10'x10') will extend to their limit. See Section 15.7 (p. 97).
@@ 4
Turns 10 cubic feet of stone into fine powder.
@@ 5
As Un-Ice I, except affects up to 1,000 cubic feet.
@@ 6
Turns 1 cubic foot of any inorganic material to fine powder (must be one
object).
@@ 7
As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet.
@@ 8
Can shatter an inorganic object, up to 1 cubic foot in volume; all within 5'
take an 'A' Impact critical, holder takes a 'C' Impact critical. Metal objects
get a special +30 RR modification.
@@ 9
As Powder Stone I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet.
@@ 10
As Un-Ice I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster.
@@ 11
As Disruption I, except affects up to 10 cubic feet.
@@ 12
As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 1,000 cubic feet.
@@ 13
Causes cracks to appear in up to 100 cubic feet of non-metal, inorganic
material.
@@ 14
As Powder Stone I, except affects 1,000 cubic feet.
@@ 15
Completely disintegrates 1 cubic feet of inorganic material.
@@ 17
As any single spell (10th level or lower) from this list, except with a range
of 300'.
@@ 19
As Disintegration I, except affects 10 cubic feet.
@@ 20
As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the
caster.
@@ 25
As Powder Stone I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the
caster.
@@ 30
As Disruption I, except up to as many objects (up to 1 cubic foot each) as the
caster’s level can be affected, and range is 100'.
@@ 50
As Disintegration I, except affects objects up to 100 cubic feet and range is
300'.
